artworks.title: The Four Avenging Angels
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to block): 39.5 × 28.4 cm (15 9/16 × 11 3/16 in.)
overall (with added margin): 42.6 × 32.2 cm (16 3/4 × 12 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial and earthly battle scene. The artwork depicts angels battling against demons and mythical creatures. In the upper section, there is a heavenly figure seated above an ornate pedestal, surrounded by other celestial beings. The lower section shows dynamic combat, with winged figures wielding swords amidst a tumult of bodies and creatures, some on horseback. The setting is against a backdrop of clouds, adding to the movement and tension. The detail and lines emphasize the epic nature of the scene.

artworks.title: Philosopher Seated, with Globe, Book, and Compass
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: There is a man seated, looking at an open book. He wears a turban-like headpiece, beard and draped robes. Nearby are an open book, a spherical object, another open book in his left hand, and a staff with a snake coiled around it. The background shows large vertical rock formations or trees to the left, against a plain sky.

artworks.title: Head of a Boy
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on blue paper
artworks.description: The image is a profile drawing of a young boy, showing the side of his head and shoulders. The boy is positioned in profile facing to the left. His facial features are delicately detailed with a smooth forehead, slightly pronounced nose, and closed lips. His hair appears short and textured with gentle waves. He is dressed in a simple buttoned garment that only covers his shoulders. The background is a plain, textured surface that contrasts with the darker lines of the drawing.

artworks.title: Design for a Window (Hunting Scene)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with touches of gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a heraldic coat of arms. The central focus of the image is an ornate coat of arms featuring a shield with two crossed objects, possibly maces or batons, with feathered ends. Surrounding the shield is intricate scrollwork and a decorative mantling. The scene is framed by three large arches in the upper part of the composition, adorned with foliage and various creatures. Above the arches, a narrative scene unfolds in the distance with figures engaged in activity amidst trees and a distant cityscape. Flanking both sides of the shield are human figures and animals, including deer. The detailed linework and classic composition evoke a rich tradition of heraldry.

artworks.title: Two Studies of a Standing Woman
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows two figures in different positions. On the right, a larger figure is depicted standing with their hands gathered at their waist. The facial features are minimal, and the hair is short or tucked back. The clothing is flowing and layered. On the left, a smaller figure is shown in a dynamic posture, leaning forward with one leg extended behind. The facial features are simplified, and the clothing appears as a long dress or shirt in motion. No jewelry or objects are shown. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Study of a Female Nude
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on blue-green paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a full-body portrait of a person standing with a slight contrapposto pose, with one leg crossed over the other. The person is shown nude, with both arms raised and hands appearing to be wrapping or holding something over their head. The facial features are delicately drawn, with a serene or neutral expression and slightly wavy hair. There is no clothing, but there appears to be some fabric or element they are interacting with above their head. The background of the drawing is a plain, textured surface without any distinct features or objects. The drawing is bordered by a double frame that adds an outline to the composition.

artworks.title: Allegory of Age
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed drawing of three people from the shoulders up. The central figure faces right in profile, displaying distinct facial features such as wrinkles and a prominent nose, alongside curly hair and a head covering. They wear flowing garments with intricate linework. One hand rests on their chest. The person on the left faces front, with soft facial features, long flowing hair, and similar loose-fitting attire. Another figure on the right has curly hair, similar facial details, and matching attire. The background is textured with cross-hatched shading and lines, without specific objects or scenery.

artworks.title: Study for Miraculous Draught of Fishes (?)
artworks.medium: black chalk with touches of white chalk on brown paper
artworks.description: The image is a detailed pencil sketch featuring multiple studies of human figures and parts. Most of the figures are shown as busts or partial figure studies. The largest figure on the right depicts a muscular man viewed from the torso up, with his arms flexed. Just below him, an arm and clenched hand are shown separately. The central figure is a woman shown from the waist up. She is wearing a textured outfit and appears to be balancing a basket or container on her head, with her arm raised for support. On the left, two faces are drawn; one is of a woman with wavy hair, and the other is of an older man with curly hair and a beard. Above them, an isolated sketch of a foot is depicted. The background is plain and unadorned, allowing the drawn figures and elements to remain the primary focus.

artworks.title: The "Palais Tutelle" near Bordeaux
artworks.artist: Attributed to Jacques Androuet Ducerceau I
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing depicts the ruins of a classical building. The structure features tall columns, Corinthian in style, with elaborate capitals adorned with acanthus leaves and volutes. The precision in the drawing showcases arches and entablature details. The building appears elevated with a base that includes a solid foundation and a few barred windows. Faint inscriptions at the top of the drawing indicate possible location as Bordeaux. The artist uses delicate lines and shading to convey depth and texture, providing a classical and timeless feel.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Alexander of Bergamo
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite; some corrections on horse's head with white gouache; squared with graphite; on two sheets joined vertically
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting military figures and landscapes. The artwork includes different sections showing various scenes: a group of figures conversing, armored figures on horseback, and a figure with a large spear. The background includes foliage, clouds, and distant structures. The drawing uses lines and shading to create depth and narrative related to military or historical events.

artworks.title: Cupid Bound
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch depicting two infants. Only the upper half of their bodies is visible. One infant is positioned to the left, facing forward, while the other infant is to the right, facing to the side. Their facial features are outlined with simple curves and lines, indicating minimal detail. The hair is depicted with short strokes or shading, suggesting short hair. The infants are wrapped in a cloth that covers their torsos. The focus is on the general form rather than clothing details. There is no visible jewelry or objects held by the infants. The background is plain and consistent with the paper's texture, showing a light brown tone with visible grain and a circular stamp in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: The Good Thief
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and (orange?) wash, heightened with white
artworks.description: The image features a male figure seated in a cave-like setting. He is mostly nude, with draped fabric covering his lower body. The figure is reclining, looking upward with a contemplative expression. Detailed facial features include defined cheekbones and slightly wavy hair. No jewelry or objects are visible. In the background, there is a depiction of a crucifixion with three crosses and onlookers to the left. Above, cherubic figures are on a cloud holding divine symbols. The background shows a distant cityscape and has a somber palette of earthy tones.

artworks.title: Two Male Nudes
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two male figures in full-body outline. The figure on the left is slightly turned towards the viewer with one arm bent and the other extended towards the figure on the right. The figure on the right faces forward with one arm pointing outward. Both figures have muscular builds and detailed anatomical features. The figure on the right has defined facial features, including a mustache and upward-styled hair. The figure on the left has less detailed facial features and closely cropped or pulled back hair. Both figures seem to be nude, holding circular shields. The background is plain and tan, resembling aged paper, with no additional context, focusing solely on the figures.

artworks.title: Landscape with Bridge and Ruins in Background
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene from a slightly elevated perspective, suggesting a view from a hillside looking down into a valley. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, with the sky meeting distant hills and faint outlines of castle-like structures. Loose, sketch-like brushstrokes convey a sense of quick study or draft. The use of ink wash and pen creates a monochromatic color palette ranging from light beige to deep browns. A path winds up a slope with a wooden fence or structure on the right, and two figures are on the path as it descends into the valley. In the distance, clusters of trees and shrubs surround scattered ruins on the horizon, adding depth. Lightly sketched clouds add texture to the sky.

artworks.title: God the Father and Angels on Clouds
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure surrounded by angels. The central figure is seated on clouds or ethereal forms, raising a hand, while cherubic angels with wings surround the figure. Two larger angels are depicted playing stringed musical instruments to the left and right. Small, winged figures fill the background. The drawing is rendered with delicate lines and shading.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: watercolor
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a dirt path curving in the foreground. A wooden cart is being pulled by a horse on the left, and a person walks near a small bridge on the right. Large trees with dense foliage line the background, framing the scene. The horizon is in the middle distance, with a vague hint of a castle or large structure. Clouds and light mist soften the distant view. The painting is done in watercolor with smooth brushstrokes capturing a tranquil countryside. Earthy tones dominate the color palette, with soft greens for trees and muted blues for the sky.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Large Rock
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape featuring a towering cliff on the left side. The horizon is not visible, with the rock formation dominating the scene. At the top of the cliff, there is a small structure. The artwork is done in sepia tones, giving it an old, textured look. The color palette is predominantly brown. A small encampment with people, a tent, and a boat are visible at the base of the cliff. The cliff's surface is depicted with rugged, layered lines, adding depth to the image.

artworks.title: Study for "The Four Doctors of the Church"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and red chalk heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features two individuals shown from mid-torso up. The person in the foreground is seated and turned slightly away from the viewer, revealing the back and profile of their head. This person leans forward, extending their right arm in a gesturing pose towards the other figure. Both individuals have curly hair and bearded profiles. Their clothing is draped and sketchy in style. The background is textured with hints of cross-hatching, and the scene is rendered in a sketch-like, sepia-toned drawing style. Written text at the bottom attributes the work to Sebastiano Mazzoni Fiorentino.

artworks.title: Japanese Artist at Work
artworks.medium: graphite on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures partially visible from the waist up. A woman stands in the foreground on the right, smiling and holding a small potted plant and a cylindrical container with florals. On her left, a child peeks from behind large plants, with tousled hair framing her face. On the left, another adult figure is seated, focused on intricate work. In the background, the scene is set in an interior space with walls adorned by bird-themed paintings or prints and a reflection of another person. There's a visible portion of what seems to be a window or door behind the seated figure, with complex imagery visible through it.

artworks.title: A Standing Man in Classical Drapery
artworks.medium: brown and gray wash with white heightening over black  chalk on green-blue paper laid on brown washed paper and then on an eighteenth-century French mount
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a male figure from the knees up. The man is in a seated position, with his torso slightly turned to one side and his head looking in the opposite direction. His facial features are not detailed, but the outline suggests a firm expression and a prominent forehead. He has short hair that is indicated with soft strokes. The figure is dressed in a flowing robe, draped over his shoulders and falls in folds around his body. There are no visible objects or jewelry being held or worn by the figure. The background is a plain, textured surface with shading, and the edges of the artwork are framed with a border.

artworks.title: Winter Landscape
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape featuring precise lines and detailing, offering a bird's-eye view of a riverside scene. Figures in historical clothing interact with the river, while arched ruins and trees are visible to the left. Windmills are outlined on the horizon, adding depth to the scene. The sky above is filled with clouds and birds. The color palette is monochrome, using contrasting ivory and black lines for detail. The etched lines create texture and convey movement and light play across the landscape.

artworks.title: Blekerye aededuyne gelegen (Farms and Bleaching-Fields)
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated angle looking down onto a rural scene. Trees, buildings, including thatched cottages and barns, define the horizon. The brushstrokes create detailed textures in the roofs and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and white tones for contrast. A wooden fence separates the viewer from people and animals. A small village or farmstead is surrounded by trees in the distance. The sky features linear etching suggesting clouds with birds.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Man
artworks.medium: black and red chalk heightened with white chalk
artworks.description: The artwork is a portrait showing the upper half of a person's body. The individual is positioned facing forward with a slight tilt to the right side. The facial features are detailed, with prominent eyes, a well-defined nose, and slightly parted lips. The hair is medium length, dark, and appears straight, framing the face naturally. The person is clothed in a garment with a textured collar, drawn in sketchy strokes. The background of the image is a textured, neutral tone. No jewelry or objects are present in the image.

artworks.title: Midnight
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
